notes.title: Supporter packs
notes.content:
Our Game is actively being developed but we need your help. We announce the support phase of the project, in which we offer unique opportunities for our sponsors.

Now you can buy add-ons with unique customization options for the game, and we undertake to fulfill all conditions of the add-on. For example, to add a unique frame or avatar, change parts of the game's interface design, etc.

[h2][b]Supporter pack[/b][/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43290375/fabd435cec5b6da7d93e3f50634ca1d6280fc3ad.png[/img]

[b]Your stylized avatar will be available to all players in the game and allow you to distinguish yourself from other players. You can describe how you'd like your avatar to look like, or provide an image, You can also provide a description of yourself and your interests, and we'll add it to your avatar along with a link to your social networks if you like.

You will get access to all frames and avatars that are in the game, regardless of your level of subscription to Battle Pass [/b]


[h2][b]Medium Support Pack[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43290375/374f2c5a557775c74e0339cde2e2a6f80d5bd9cc.png[/img]

[b]In the developer packs we will add a sponsor question in which your nickname will be mentioned, so all players can see that you support the game. We can also add links to your social networks and add art based on your description. It can be your logo or other ideas you suggest.

Your frame idea will be taken as a basis for new frames, and if your idea is implemented we will give it a unique name on your request.

You will also get a chance to choose the color of your nickname to stand out from the rest of the players.[/b]

We are willing to accept any suggestions you may have and fulfill the terms of the add-on within a realistic timeframe. Together we can make our game better and more interesting for all users.

Thank you for your support.
